name: [🥳]Card RNG
desc:
Unlock Epic Loot! Tap to open card packs with the roll button! Aim for cards with high rarities and powerful abilities! Craft charms and collect mystical potions to maximize your luck! Dive into our RPG-style card battles. Conquer bosses for unique perks and flex on the leaderboards! 

The End 🕧
We are sadly, no longer updating Card RNG. We have a sequel, Card RNG 2, coming out. This is the last update, and our anniversary event.

----------------------- 
Join the communications and follow the creators for codes, updates, and sneak peeks.
